description.default: Absence of a resource (op365_absence): Vacation, Leave or Sickness; with type Closure and no Resource it is a company closure. Synonyms: Italian assenza, ferie, permesso, malattia; French absence, congé, maladie; German Abwesenheit, Urlaub, Krankheit.
